table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	 prinvcode = dbo.prledger.prinvcode, 
	 date = dbo.prledger.date, 
	 invdiscperc = dbo.prledger.discperc, 
	 flatdisc = dbo.prledger.flatdisc, 
	 misccharges = dbo.prledger.misccharges, 
	 invsalestax = dbo.prledger.salestax,
	 invgstperc1 = dbo.prledger.invgstperc1,
	 invtype = Case dbo.prledger.prcatcode 	When 4 Then 'Cash Purchase Return' 	When 5 Then 'Credit Purchase Return'  Else 'Opening Purchase Return' End,  	   
	 looseqty = dbo.prdetail.looseqty, 
	 packqty  = prdetail.packqty, 
	 unitsalestax = dbo.prdetail.unitsalestax,
	 gstperc = dbo.prdetail.gstperc,
	 quantity = dbo.prdetail.looseqty + prdetail.packqty, 
	 bonusqty  = prdetail.bonusqty, 	  
	 price = dbo.prdetail.prprice,    
	 itemdiscperc = dbo.prdetail.discperc,    
	 packunits = dbo.prdetail.packunits,    
	 packing=   case when dbo.item.packcode is null then space(30)
						  else  dbo.itempacking.name
					 end,
	 batch = dbo.prdetail.batch,    
	 expiry = dbo.prdetail.expiry,    
	 itemname = item.name,
	 datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, prledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, prledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, prledger.date)))), 
	 Person = dbo.accounts.name,
	totalsalestax = (SELECT invtotalsalestax= 
									  Round (
	/*invoice level salestax*/Round ( ( Round ( Sum ( Round ( ( PD.looseqty + PD.packqty ) * PD.prprice * (1 - PD.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) )
									 * ( 1 - PL.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) - PL.flatdisc ) * PL.invgstperc1 * 0.01  , 2 )
	/*items salestax*/		 + Sum (Round ( (PD.looseqty + PD.packqty + PD.bonusqty)* PD.unitsalestax + Round ( Round ( (PD.looseqty + PD.packqty) * PD.prprice * (1 - PD.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * PD.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )						 
									 , ISNULL((SELECT A=dbo.Fn_Get_Int_Preference('roundpurinvon')), 0))
						 FROM dbo.Prledger PL , 
								dbo.Prdetail PD

						 WHERE  (PL.prinvcode = dbo.prledger.prinvcode )   and
								  (PL.prinvcode = PD.prinvcode )   
		
						 GROUP BY PL.prinvcode, 
									 PL.misccharges,   
									 PL.flatdisc,   
									 PL.invgstperc1, 
									 PL.discperc
						)

FROM
	dbo.prledger, 
	dbo.prdetail,    
	dbo.item
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.itempacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode),
	dbo.accounts
WHERE  
	dbo.prledger.posted = 'N' and
	dbo.prledger.suppcode = :ai_suppcode  and
	dbo.prledger.prcatcode IN (4, 5, 6) and
	dbo.prledger.prinvcode = dbo.prdetail.prinvcode and  
	dbo.prdetail.icode = item.icode and 
	dbo.prledger.suppcode = dbo.accounts.acccode

objects.name: c_totaldisc
objects.expression: sum(  flatdisc for all Distinct  prinvcode  )

objects.name: c_totalsalestax
objects.expression: Round (Sum ( totalsalestax for all distinct prinvcode) , f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon'))

objects.name: c_totalmisccharges
objects.expression: sum(  misccharges for all Distinct  prinvcode  )

objects.name: c_totalamount
objects.expression: Round ( Sum( c_amount for all) + sum( misccharges for all distinct  prinvcode ) -  sum(  flatdisc  for all distinct  prinvcode ) -  sum(  Round(( quantity   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 )  ) * (   invdiscperc  * 0.01 )   , 2)   for all ) , f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon'))  + Round ( Sum ( totalsalestax  for all distinct prinvcode ) , f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon'))

objects.name: c_itemsalestax
objects.expression: Round ( ( (quantity + bonusqty) *  unitsalestax ) + Round ( c_amount *  gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) ,  2 )

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round ( Sum((  quantity   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (  itemdiscperc * .01 )  ) for group 2 )  *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )  -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  invsalestax , f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon'))  +  Round( totalsalestax , f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon'))

objects.name: c_invsalestax
objects.expression: Round (  invgstperc1 * 0.01 * Sum ( c_amount for group 2) , 2 )
